title: Line sketch: Crowned Solitude
description: Black-and-white ink line sketch on white paper — pure contour and edge drawing with no color fills. Edge-traced line art of: A solitary queen in profile sits poised on a geometric ledge, her crown and flowing hair glowing against a deep, shadowy void. The minimalist scene evokes a sense of majestic isolation and quiet contemplation (derived from painting #898).
